seo.title: PRECIA — Clinical AI Platform for Hospitals and Clinics
seo.description: PRECIA runs clinical AI modules (AI-ECG screening, AI-BOO Multimodal uroflowmetry) in one platform. Faster screening, the doctor still decides, full audit trail for compliance.

hero.title_after: screening, decisions still made by the doctor
hero.subtitle: PRECIA runs clinical AI modules, from ECG to uroflowmetry, in one system. Hospitals don't need a new app every time a new module ships.
hero.stat3_label: Data mutations logged to the audit trail

problems.title: Four daily burdens for hospitals and doctors

items.title: Long examination queues
items.description: Dozens of readings a day, quality swings when doctors get tired.
items.solution: Initial screening comes out in 30 seconds, consistent every time.

items.title: Every AI tool has its own app
items.description: Staff switch apps and log in repeatedly, a new module means a new procurement.
items.solution: Every module lives in one platform, one account, one workflow.

items.title: Audit and compliance take time
items.description: Tracing who checked what and when is still manual.
items.solution: Every data mutation is logged automatically and ready to trace.

items.title: Fear that AI disrupts an existing workflow
items.description: Integrations are often long, expensive, and change clinic habits.
items.solution: Complements the running system, doctors still make the call.

how.title: Four steps, no change to clinic habits

steps.title: Data comes in
steps.description: ECG recordings or uroflowmetry results are uploaded to the patient's clinical transaction.

steps.title: AI screens it
steps.description: The relevant AI module runs and returns a result within 30 seconds.

steps.title: Doctor reviews
steps.description: Confidence score and result explanation are shown. The doctor decides.

steps.title: Everything is logged
steps.description: AI and user activity go into the audit trail for compliance.

modules.title: One platform, many specialties
modules.subtitle: New modules join the same platform, no separate app install and no extra account.

items.name: AI-ECG (EF Screening)
items.description: Helps doctors screen for signs of reduced heart pumping function from a standard ECG recording.
items.roadmap: EF and mitral valve from ECG images, plus ECG image quality control.

items.name: AI-BOO Multimodal
items.description: Screens for Bladder Outlet Obstruction from a uroflowmetry waveform and patient clinical data.
items.roadmap: Other AI-BOO variants and Detrusor Underactivity screening.

items.name: AI-Ortho
items.description: Analyzes frontal and side facial photos to assess symmetry and proportion.
items.roadmap: Development direction is set, we're open to discussing pilot trials.

items.name: New module
items.description: We keep adding AI modules based on what partner hospitals and clinics need.
items.roadmap: Have a specific screening need? Let's discuss it with our team.

showcase.title: AI results a doctor can read and trace
showcase.ecg_alt: AI-ECG EF Screening result in PRECIA
showcase.ecg_caption: AI-ECG: confidence score, classification, and a reading guide. Clinical confirmation is still required.
showcase.uroflow_alt: AI-BOO Multimodal result with uroflowmetry waveform in PRECIA
showcase.uroflow_caption: AI-BOO Multimodal: the part of the uroflowmetry waveform that most influenced the prediction is shown too.
